shared_elements: parallel incised hatching used as surface infill
curved/rounded body form covered with repeating linear pattern
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces use fine parallel incised lines as repeated infill, in A to render feather rows on a bird's folded wings and in B as abstract hatched bands and triangles wrapping a rounded body. A depicts a recognisable creature in the round with hooked beak, head, wings and feet, while B depicts no figural subject at all, only non-representational geometric ornament, so no shared iconographic scheme can be claimed.
